name: Lever Postings
summary: A company's published Lever job postings, filterable by location, team, department and commitment, keyless.

host.description: api.eu.lever.co for companies whose Lever account is hosted in the EU; a site on the wrong host returns not found.

notes: Keyless for reading published postings. Applying to a posting (POST with an API key, rate limited to 2 per second) is not in this entry.
Each call is scoped to one company's site; there is no cross-company search.
Filter values (location, commitment, team, department) are case-sensitive and must match the posting exactly.

endpoints.name: List job postings
endpoints.summary: A company's published postings with text, categories (team, department, location, commitment), lists and apply URLs.

site.description: The company's Lever site name: the slug in jobs.lever.co/<site>.

mode.description: Output mode: json, html or iframe; json for data. Wins over the Accept header.

skip.description: Skip this many results from the start.

limit.description: Return at most this many results.

notes: Pass mode=json; without it the format follows the Accept header.
A filter may repeat to OR values; this catalog sends one value per parameter.

endpoints.name: Get a job posting
endpoints.summary: One posting by id, as JSON.

site.description: The company's Lever site name: the slug in jobs.lever.co/<site>.

posting_id.description: The posting id from the list.
